_comment: Reinhard's kill quest and the Mill-on-the-river POI's whole reason to exist (content-zone-design-guide.md §2.4: soft dead end, side reward). Target: the single AlphaBoar spawn at the mill — Zone 1's one elite. ⭐ COUNT 1, and that is the design rather than a shortcut: every other kill quest in the game is a cull (6 boars, 8 wolves) and this one is a NAMED FIGHT, which is how the player learns that an elite is a different kind of thing from more of the same. It leans on the respawn only if they lose. Reward on the turn-in row (miller.json): 370 XP = the L9 half-level rule at L6, the same number the Lamplighter pays. Text deliberately plain (PO 2026-08-02: no lore or stylized quest text yet).
title: The Beast of the Farmlands
